feature: Add JSON Export Format for Candidate Bulk Actions
description: Verify that JSON export functionality works correctly for candidate bulk actions (already implemented in codebase)
workflow_rationale: The JSON export feature is already fully implemented in both frontend and backend. This is a verification-only task to confirm the existing implementation works correctly. No new code needs to be written.

phases.name: Verify JSON Export Implementation
phases.description: Verify that the existing JSON export functionality works correctly by running tests and manual verification

subtasks.description: Review existing JSON export implementation in backend

verification.instructions: Review backend/api/candidates.py lines 1797-1966 to confirm JSON export logic exists and handles the format correctly. Confirm that when export_format != 'csv', it returns JSON format with {format: 'json', data: [...], count: N}.

subtasks.notes: VERIFIED: JSON export implementation exists and works correctly. Lines 1960-1966 return {format: 'json', data: exported_candidates, count: N} when export_format != 'csv'. Export data includes id, filename, current_stage, stage_name, vacancy_id, created_at, updated_at, tags fields.

subtasks.description: Review existing JSON export implementation in frontend

verification.instructions: Review BulkCandidateActions.tsx to confirm: (1) exportFormat state has 'json' option, (2) handleBulkExport passes export_format to backend, (3) Response handler creates Blob with 'application/json' type, (4) Export dialog has JSON/CSV format selection

subtasks.notes: VERIFIED: All four requirements confirmed. (1) Line 150: exportFormat state typed as 'json' | 'csv' with default 'json'; (2) Lines 285-289: handleBulkExport passes export_format to backend; (3) Lines 295-304: Blob created with 'application/json' type for JSON; (4) Lines 724-735: Export dialog has JSON/CSV format selection dropdown.

subtasks.description: Run existing backend verification tests for JSON export

verification.expected: All verifications passed including 'Bulk export (JSON) works correctly'

subtasks.notes: The verify_bulk_actions.py script already tests JSON export functionality

subtasks.description: Perform manual end-to-end test of JSON export

steps: Start backend server (cd backend && uvicorn main:app --reload)
Start frontend server (cd frontend && npm run dev)
Navigate to application and search for candidates
Select multiple candidates using BulkCandidateActions component
Click 'Export' button and select 'JSON' format from dropdown
Verify that a JSON file is downloaded with candidate data
Open the JSON file and verify it contains valid JSON with candidate fields (id, filename, current_stage, tags, etc.)

subtasks.notes: Manual verification to ensure the complete user flow works

subtasks.description: Document the JSON export feature if documentation is missing

verification.instructions: Check if user documentation or API documentation mentions JSON export format for bulk actions. If not, create a brief documentation snippet explaining how to use the feature (frontend: select candidates, click export, choose JSON; backend: POST to /api/candidates/bulk-action with action='export' and export_format='json')

subtasks.notes: Optional: Add documentation if it doesn't exist

discovery.key_finding: JSON export feature is already fully implemented in both frontend and backend. The spec appears to have been created from an outdated understanding or incorrect assumption about the codebase state.
evidence: Backend bulk_action endpoint (candidates.py:1467-1997) handles export_format parameter
Backend returns JSON format when export_format != 'csv' (lines 1960-1966)
Frontend has exportFormat state with 'json' | 'csv' options (line 150)
Frontend handleBulkExport passes export_format to API (lines 285-289)
Verification script exists and tests JSON export (verify_bulk_actions.py:362-434)
discovery.conclusion: No implementation work required. Only verification needed to confirm existing implementation works.
